highlights: AI agent development is rapidly accelerating with new open-source frameworks for reinforcement learning, specialized agents for critical applications like clinical reasoning and hardware verification, and enhanced managed agent platforms from major providers.

Efficiency and cost-effectiveness are key themes, with new tools enabling significant reductions in token costs for LLMs, faster inference on commodity hardware, and optimized training frameworks for large-scale models.

Major AI companies are expanding their reach and impact, evidenced by OpenAI providing free access to advanced models for academic research, launching health data integration in ChatGPT, and introducing enterprise-grade agent platforms.

agents.title: Kimi AI and kvcache-ai Open Sources 'AgentENV': A Distributed System for Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) Training
agents.summary: Kimi AI and kvcache-ai have open-sourced AgentENV, an MIT-licensed distributed system that powers agentic reinforcement learning training. It leverages Firecracker microVMs for millisecond snapshot/resume and 16-way forking, offering an E2B-compatible API for scalable agent development.

agents.title: GuideSkill: Evolving Executable LLM Agent Skills for Guideline-Grounded Clinical Reasoning
agents.summary: GuideSkill introduces an external reasoning layer that compiles clinical practice guidelines into executable functions, significantly improving LLM agent accuracy in diagnostic reasoning. It supports both guideline-initialized and case-evolved skills, offering a model-agnostic mechanism for combining structured knowledge with case-derived patterns.

agents.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
agents.summary: Google has significantly expanded its Gemini API Managed Agents with new capabilities, including support for Gemini 3.6 Flash, enhanced hooks, background tasks, and remote MCP. These updates enable developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents with advanced control and scalability.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-Encoder-230M and LFM2.5-Encoder-350M: Bidirectional Encoders That Stay Fast at 8K Context on CPU
models.summary: Liquid AI has released LFM2.5-Encoder-230M and LFM2.5-Encoder-350M, two open-weight bidirectional encoders built on the LFM2 hybrid backbone. These models achieve fast inference at 8K context on CPUs, with the 350M model ranking highly across 17 tasks on GLUE, SuperGLUE, and multilingual suites.

models.title: Microsoft AI Releases MAI-Cyber-1-Flash: A 5B-Active-Parameter Cyber Model That Pushes MDASH to 95.95% on CyberGym
models.summary: Microsoft AI has launched MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, a specialized 5B active-parameter sparse MoE model for cyber defense. This model, a fine-tune of MAI-Code-1-Flash with a 256k context window, runs within Microsoft's MDASH agentic scanning harness, significantly boosting its performance on CyberGym benchmarks.

models.title: How GPT-5.6 fuses frontier intelligence with frontier efficiency
models.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 introduces significant advancements in AI efficiency, optimizing across models, inference, and agentic workflows. This development aims to provide enhanced intelligence at a lower cost, making advanced AI capabilities more accessible and practical for diverse applications.

tools.title: Tencent Open-Sources AngelSpec: A Unified Training Framework for MTP and Block-Parallel Speculative Decoding on Hy3 Models
tools.summary: Tencent has open-sourced AngelSpec, a torch-native framework that unifies training for speculative-decoding draft models across six architectures. It introduces DFly, a block-diffusion drafter, and integrates D-cut, delivering 1.98–2.40x speedup for autoregressive decoding on HY3-295B-A21B.

tools.title: Meet Token Saver: An Open-Source MCP Extension Using Local Hybrid RAG to Cut Claude PDF Token Costs 90-99%
tools.summary: Marktechpost AI has released Token Saver, an open-source MCP extension for Claude Desktop that significantly reduces PDF token consumption by 90-99% using local Hybrid RAG. This tool ensures absolute document privacy while offering substantial cost savings for Claude users.

tools.title: Fireworks AI Releases Fireworks Nexus: A Drop-In Routing and Cost-Control Layer That Moves Routine Coding Work to Open-Weight Models
tools.summary: Fireworks AI has launched Fireworks Nexus, an AI management and routing platform for engineering organizations. It connects existing coding tools to a managed layer of open-weight models, designed to significantly reduce AI operational costs by intelligently routing routine coding tasks to more efficient solutions.

companies.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
companies.summary: OpenAI is providing free access to its most advanced ChatGPT models for 100,000 academic researchers, aiming to accelerate scientific research, foster collaboration, and drive new discoveries across various fields.

companies.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI is launching 'Health in ChatGPT,' allowing eligible U.S. users to securely connect their medical records and Apple Health data. This feature provides personalized insights and enhanced understanding of individual health information directly within ChatGPT.

companies.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
companies.summary: OpenAI has introduced OpenAI Presence, a proven enterprise AI agent platform designed to help organizations deploy trusted voice and chat agents. It streamlines customer and internal workflows by providing secure and reliable agent capabilities.

learning.title: Prompt Engineering vs Loop Engineering vs Graph Engineering: What Changes at Each Layer
learning.summary: This article differentiates between Prompt Engineering, Loop Engineering, and Graph Engineering, clarifying their distinct roles and applications in AI development. It addresses common misconceptions about these terms, providing a foundational understanding for AI practitioners.

learning.title: Building Non-Interactive Agentic Coding Workflows with Moonshot AI’s Kimi CLI, JSONL Streaming, Testing, and Session Memory
learning.summary: This tutorial demonstrates how to configure and operate Moonshot AI’s Kimi CLI as a fully non-interactive AI coding agent. It covers installation, API authentication, building a reusable Python wrapper, and applying Kimi to solve coding tasks, emphasizing session memory and testing.

learning.title: Position: Evaluation Scores Are Perishable Knowledge Claims
learning.summary: This paper argues that AI evaluation scores are perishable epistemic claims, highlighting 'trust inflation' when aggregating diverse signals. It proposes treating scores with explicit metadata—formality tier, scope declaration, and expiration date—to ensure transparency and prevent misinterpretation, especially with weakest-link aggregation.
